inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The manuscript names the closest comparator frameworks, states the shared producer-checker features and the P33-specific owner semantics, and bounds every originality statement to documented support.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript provides a focused comparison that names the closest comparator frameworks, identifies the producer-checker features shared with them, distinguishes P33's mathematical owner semantics, and limits every originality or priority statement to the documentary support supplied by that comparison.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies a genuine closest-work comparison or narrows some originality language, but one or more required elements remain absent or incomplete: named closest frameworks, shared producer-checker features, P33-specific owner semantics, or documentary bounds on every originality statement.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A regression occurs if the manuscript broadens or strengthens originality or priority claims beyond documented support, removes or obscures an existing limitation on those claims, or makes the closest-work comparison less specific or less traceable.
